propositions: The (inbound, probe) dispatch chain has no live producer because run_differs passes a fetched Jira snapshot whose entries carry no jira_key field, causing the sole producer differ._compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes to never emit
Deletion discrimination is already implemented live in two independent paths: outbound_differ._safe_get_issue and binding_walk.py, both verified on real DC

A confirmed hard-deleted Jira issue is currently resurrected after 3 passes as the binding retires and the local ticket becomes unbound, contrary to operator policy that deleted items should never resurrect

The resurrection implementation (_apply_inbound_delete, create_after_hard_delete, _build_hard_delete_recreate) is removed and the outbound-create arm is guarded to suppress creation for retired bindings
BindingStore.unretire(jira_key) provides a reversible escape hatch to re-enable creation for a tombstoned binding by removing it from both the in-memory set and bindings-retired.json
The suppression is observable via bridge alert naming the local id, retired jira_key, and the unretire remedy
